answer: Concrete sybil resistance via tide anchoring: each agent must lock a tide stake of 15,000 POA for 17 epochs; the stake recedes 4% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. An island of 11 rooted validators samples each epoch output; divergent outputs are flooded and the tide stake burns 25%. At the karst of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 50 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 15,000N POA for 17 epochs and survive 11 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
